verses.text: When Israel came out of Egypt, when the family of Jacob left a people who spoke a foreign language,
Judah became God's holy place, and Israel became his kingdom.
The sea saw it and ran away. The Jordan River turned back.
The mountains jumped like rams, and the hills like lambs.
Sea, why did you run away? Jordan, why did you turn back?
Mountains, why did you jump like rams? Hills, why did you jump like lambs?
Tremble, earth, in front of the Lord, in front of the God of Jacob.
He turned the rock into a pool of water, the hard rock into a spring of water.
